text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With summer camp coming up, Super<n>Creek
gushes about wanting to spoil<n>me rotten.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She also wants to find a way to<n>overcome her bad
health.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After surmising what the cause of her<n>condition
might be, I make it my goal<n>to have her change her
mindset.
